title: Derived homotopy-pullback row strictification
statement: Given short exact rows S, T, R and row maps u : S ⟶ R and v : T ⟶ R whose three localized components are isomorphisms, construct a short exact row P with localized isomorphic projection to S, a map to T, and the three localized span equations.

proof.text: Transpose the rows to complexes of rows. The mapping-cocone row is short exact degreewise by biproduct exactness. The distinguished mapping-cocone triangle identifies each projection with an isomorphism after localization when the corresponding component of v is an isomorphism, and its zero composite gives the three span equations.

proof_origin.place: Homotopy pullback of short exact rows.

lean.statement:
theorem relativeMV_homotopyPullback_row_strictify
    (S T R : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (u : S ⟶ R) (v : T ⟶ R)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (hT : T.ShortExact) (hR : R.ShortExact)
    [IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₁)]
    [IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₂)]
    [IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₃)] :
    ∃ (P : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (p : P ⟶ S) (m : P ⟶ T),
      P.ShortExact ∧ IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₁) ∧
      IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₂) ∧ IsIso (DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₃) ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₁ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map u.τ₁ =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₁ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₂ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map u.τ₂ =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₂ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map p.τ₃ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map u.τ₃ =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map v.τ₃
